But the gathering will still require extensive maneuvering over senior appointments and policy priorities. 在北京力求在明年中共全国代表大会前营造平稳外部环境之际，展现习近平以及中国的国际影响力尤为重要。尽管他身边的高层人事可能迎来调整，但习近平继续执政几乎已成定局。即便如此，这场盛会仍需要围绕高层人事布局与政策优先事项展开密集的内部协调。 Repeated meetings with Mr. Trump could help keep China’s most important foreign relationship stable as Mr. Xi turns his attention to domestic politics. 在习近平将精力转回国内政治之际，与特朗普保持频密会晤有助于夯实中国最重要的一对双边关系。 And few domestic problems are more pressing than the country’s housing market crash. 而在当前，没有哪一项国内难题比房地产市场的全面崩盘更为紧迫。 The property downturn has created a cascade of problems. Falling apartment prices have eaten into household savings, while the collapse in property development has gutted the land-use revenue many local governments depended on. Apartment prices have already fallen twice as far as they did in the United States during the American housing market debacle nearly two decades ago. 楼市持续低迷引发了一连串连锁反应。房价下挫侵蚀了居民家庭的积蓄，房企倒闭潮则抽干了许多地方政府赖以维系财政的土地出让收入。当下的住宅价格跌幅已达近二十年前美国次贷危机时期房价跌幅的两倍。 Chinese families have responded by cutting back sharply on spending. Restaurants, shopping malls and car dealerships are struggling, while weak domestic demand has left China increasingly reliant on its export industries to sustain growth. 中国家庭对此做出的直接反应是急剧紧缩开支。餐饮、商场以及汽车销售行业陷入苦撑，疲软的内需迫使中国经济更加依赖出口产业来维持增长底线。 Mr. Trump returned to office threatening tariffs severe enough to reshape China’s export economy. Nearly halfway through the American president’s second term, those tariffs are modest, China’s trade surplus shows no signs of slowing, and Beijing has demonstrated considerable economic leverage. 特朗普重返白宫时曾威胁要加征足以重塑中国出口经济的严厉关税。然而，在其第二任期即将过半之际，这些关税措施显得相对温和，中国的贸易顺差扩大势头丝毫没有放缓的迹象，反而展示出了相当可观的经济制衡杠杆。 For Mr. Xi, then, another summit that ends without the steep American tariffs once threatened against Chinese exports may represent the biggest victory of all. 因此，对于习近平而言，又一场没有以美国加征高昂关税收场的峰会——这样的关税一度威胁到中国的出口——或许本身就是一种至关重要的胜利。 David Pierson自香港对本文有报道贡献。 Keith Bradsher 是《纽约时报》北京分社社长，此前曾任上海分社社长、香港分社社长、底特律分社社长，以及华盛顿记者。他在新冠疫情期间常驻中国进行报道。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 聚焦中美元首峰会：军机表演和盛大仪式背后的博弈与分歧
description: ZOLAN KANNO-YOUNGS2026年9月25日周四，习近平和彭丽媛在白宫进行国事访问期间与特朗普和梅拉尼娅合影。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times President Trump said he had “never gotten along better” with President Xi Jinping of China on Thursday during a day of military flyovers, gifts of pandas and lavish ceremonies that masked significant divides over artificial intelligence and trade.“President Xi and I both understand that we represent different systems but the ties between our people endure,” Mr. Trump said at the start of the state dinner with Mr. Xi at the White House. “Together we can continue to build a relationship that promotes prosperity and security for future generations.” 周四，特朗普总统表示，他与中国国家主席习近平“关系从未如此融洽”。这一天充满了军机飞行表演、赠送大熊猫和盛大仪式，掩盖了双方在人工智能和贸易方面的重大分歧。“习近平主席和我都明白，我们代表着不同的制度，但我们两国人民之间的纽带历久弥坚，”特朗普在白宫与习近平的国宴开始时说。“我们可以共同继续建立一种关系，促进子孙后代的繁荣与安全。” The flattery capped a day in which Mr. Trump appeared focused on growing a personal relationship with Mr. Xi to strengthen ties between the two nations, while Mr. Xi at times was more pointed on the challenges before them. 这番恭维为当天画上了句号。在这一天里，特朗普似乎专注于发展与习近平的个人关系，以加强两国之间的联系，而习近平则有时更为直截了当地指出双方面临的挑战。 After arriving to the White House earlier in the day, Mr. Xi warned that the two countries should avoid the “Thucydides Trap,” the theory that a rising power and an established power are likely to go to war.“We do not need to avoid mentioning competition, but our competition should be a healthy one and should be kept within bounds,” Mr. Xi said. “It should be a race of catching up with one another, not a wrestle in which one either wins or loses. China and the United States must hold the line of no conflict and no confrontation between us." 在当天早些时候抵达白宫后，习近平警告说，两国应避免“修昔底德陷阱”——这一理论认为，新兴大国和老牌强国之间很可能会走向战争。“中美不必讳言竞争，但竞争应该是良性的，有边界的，”习近平说。“应该是你追我赶的赛跑，而不是你输我赢的角斗。中美双方必须守住不冲突、不对抗的底线。” The two leaders did appear to broach pressing issues behind the scenes. Mr. Trump said they planned on discussing security and “super intelligence,” his attempt at rebranding artificial intelligence, technology that has spurred global concern in recent weeks. In their private meeting, the two leaders also deliberated trade, Taiwan, the Middle East and Russia’s war in Ukraine, according to the official Chinese summary of talks. 两位领导人似乎确实在幕后探讨了紧迫问题。特朗普表示，他们计划讨论安全和“超级智能” (super intelligence)——这是他为人工智能重新命名的尝试，这项技术在最近几周引发了全球担忧。根据中方关于会谈的官方摘要，在闭门会议中，两位领导人还商讨了贸易、台湾、中东以及俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争等问题。 On Wednesday, the two nations agreed to extend a shaky trade truce — that eased an intensifying trade war — by two months past a November deadline. But there was little sign of other policies that came about from the pomp and circumstance. 周三，两国同意将一项摇摇欲坠的贸易休战协议在11月的截止日期之后再延长两个月，该休战曾缓解了两国日益加剧的贸易战。但在这场盛大的仪式中，几乎看不到取得其他政策成果的迹象。 Mr. Xi, in public at least, went further than Mr. Trump on the issue of artificial intelligence. During his opening remarks at the White House, Mr. Xi said he wanted to ensure A.I. was “always under human control.” Mr. Trump has called fears about A.I. leading to mass extinction a “hoax.” 至少在公开场合，习近平在人工智能问题上的表态比特朗普走得更远。在白宫的开场致辞中，习近平表示希望确保人工智能“始终受控于人”。而特朗普则将对人工智能导致大规模灭绝的担忧称为“骗局”。 特朗普以自己的个人外交风格为傲，尽管中美之间存在竞争，但他仍对习近平给予了热情接待。 Mr. Trump, who prides himself on his personal brand of diplomacy, has extended his hand to Mr. Xi, despite the rivalry between the United States and China. Mr. Trump accused China this summer of “sinister election meddling” in the 2020 election. And Beijing has shown no signs of retreating from its business dealings with Tehran since the U.S. and Israeli war against Iran began this year.Since the start of the war, Chinese companies have even provided Tehran with satellite imagery, and access to a spy satellite, that Iran’s military forces have used to mount attacks in the region, according to multiple U.S. officials. 特朗普以自己的个人外交风格为傲，尽管中美之间存在竞争，他仍向习近平示好。今年夏天，特朗普曾指责中国在2020年大选中进行了“阴险的选举干预”。此外，自今年美以对伊朗发动战争以来，北京没有表现出任何迹象，要从与德黑兰的商业往来中退出。多位美国官员表示，自战争爆发以来，中国公司甚至向德黑兰提供了卫星图像和一颗间谍卫星的访问权限，伊朗军队利用该卫星在该地区发动了袭击。 There is little sign that China had made good on a promise made during Mr. Trump’s visit with Mr. Xi in Beijing earlier this year to sharply increase its purchases of American agriculture products. 几乎没有迹象表明中国兑现了今年早些时候特朗普在北京与习近平会面时做出的大幅增加购买美国农产品的承诺。 But Mr. Trump, who once criticized the Obama administration for hosting Mr. Xi, appeared particularly focused on playing the part of host rather than rival. 特朗普曾对奥巴马政府接待习近平做出批评，但此次他似乎格外专注于扮演东道主而非竞争对手的角色。 “In return for China breaking nearly every trade promise it has made, Trump is rolling out the red carpet for President Xi,” said Senator Ron Wyden, Democrat of Oregon. “There is no evidence that Trump is using this opportunity to push back on the Chinese government policies that hurt our workers and businesses, from forced labor to state subsidies. Donald Trump is giving away the store to China and leaving American families with the bill.” “中国几乎违背了它做出的所有贸易承诺，作为回报，特朗普却为习近平主席铺上了红毯，”俄勒冈州民主党参议员罗恩·怀登表示。“没有证据表明特朗普正在利用这个机会反击从强迫劳动到国家补贴这些损害我们工人和企业利益的中国政府政策。唐纳德·特朗普正在向中国大肆让步，却让美国家庭来买单。” On Wednesday, Mr. Trump went to Joint Base Andrews to greet Mr. Xi, breaking from the usual tradition of greeting world leaders at the White House. He presented him with an honor guard ceremony in the Rose Garden featuring a military flyover of a B2 bomber and F-22 jets. He then gave Mr. Xi a tour of his new helipad on the White House grounds. 周三，特朗普打破了总统通常在白宫迎接世界领导人的传统，前往安德鲁斯联合基地迎接习近平。他在玫瑰园为习近平举行了仪仗队欢迎仪式，其中包括B-2轰炸机和F-22战机的军机飞行表演。随后，他带习近平参观了白宫内新建的直升机停机坪。 Mr. Trump later hosted Mr. Xi for a state dinner in the East Room with Chinese officials, G.O.P. donors and a number of high-profile executives, including Jeff Bezos, Jensen Huang and Elon Musk. Rather than speak about artificial intelligence, Mr. Trump appeared to break from his scripted remarks to direct Mr. Xi to one of the points of pride of his second term. 之后，特朗普在东厅为习近平举行了国宴，中国官员、共和党捐助者以及杰夫·贝佐斯、黄仁勋和埃隆·马斯克等众多知名高管出席了晚宴。特朗普并未谈及人工智能，他似乎偏离了预先准备的讲稿，向习近平重点介绍了其第二任期内一个引以为豪的成就。 “It’s one year away from complete, the new ballroom that you’ve heard about,” Mr. Trump said. “And you will see something that I think you will really love.” “你听说过的那个新宴会厅，距离完工还有一年，”特朗普说。“到时候你会看到一些我认为你肯定非常喜欢的东西。” Mr. Xi came with gifts. He announced China would be sending two pandas to the Atlanta zoo. 习近平带来了礼物。他宣布中国将向亚特兰大动物园赠送两只大熊猫。 周三，特朗普前往安德鲁斯联合基地迎接习近平，这打破了总统通常在白宫迎接世界各国领导人的惯例。 In a Truth Social post, Mr. Trump said the day was a made-for-TV moment. But it was missing a crucial component. Major television networks declined to provide shared footage of the events after Mr. Trump blocked CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House. 在Truth Social的一篇帖文中，特朗普称这一天堪称为电视量身定做的时刻。但却缺少了一个关键要素。在特朗普禁止CNN、MS NOW和Politico进入白宫后，各大电视网拒绝提供这些活动的共享画面。 Reporters from those outlets had their access restored around midday, but the TV pool remained suspended. The networks had indicated that they would not resume coverage following the president until the White House had formally agreed to allow CNN to participate once again in the pool. 这些媒体的记者在中午前后恢复了入场权限，但电视联合采访团仍处于停摆状态。各大电视网曾表示，除非白宫正式同意让CNN再次参与电视联合采访团，否则不会恢复对总统的跟拍报道。 A crowd of Chinese state media workers were, however, allowed onto the White House grounds. 然而，一群中国官方媒体工作人员却被允许进入白宫。 After Mr. Trump’s toast at the state dinner, Mr. Xi selectively recited the history of the two countries, choosing to ignore the worst moments of the Cold War but rather invoke President Richard Nixon’s rapprochement with Beijing in 1972. The message to Trump appeared to be that he, too, had an opportunity to re-establish ties with China, though on Beijing’s terms. 在特朗普于国宴上致祝酒辞后，习近平选择性地回顾了两国的历史，他选择忽略冷战最糟糕的时刻，而是提到理查德·尼克松总统在1972年与北京的破冰和解。这向特朗普传递的信息似乎是，他也有机会重新建立与中国的关系，尽管是按照北京的条件。 “Such a friendship, forged in blood and fire,” he said, “will surely live on through the generations.” “这份血与火锻造的友谊，”习近平说，“必将世代相传。” David E. Sanger、Anton Troianovski、David Pierson、Erica L. Green和储百亮(Chris Buckley)对本文有报道贡献。 Zolan Kanno-Youngs是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

He then gave Mr. Xi a tour of his new helipad on the White House grounds. 周三，特朗普打破了总统通常在白宫迎接世界领导人的传统，前往安德鲁斯联合基地迎接习近平。他在玫瑰园为习近平举行了仪仗队欢迎仪式，其中包括B-2轰炸机和F-22战机的军机飞行表演。随后，他带习近平参观了白宫内新建的直升机停机坪。 Mr. Trump later hosted Mr. Xi for a state dinner in the East Room with Chinese officials, G.O.P. donors and a number of high-profile executives, including Jeff Bezos, Jensen Huang and Elon Musk. Rather than speak about artificial intelligence, Mr. Trump appeared to break from his scripted remarks to direct Mr. Xi to one of the points of pride of his second term. 之后，特朗普在东厅为习近平举行了国宴，中国官员、共和党捐助者以及杰夫·贝佐斯、黄仁勋和埃隆·马斯克等众多知名高管出席了晚宴。特朗普并未谈及人工智能，他似乎偏离了预先准备的讲稿，向习近平重点介绍了其第二任期内一个引以为豪的成就。 “It’s one year away from complete, the new ballroom that you’ve heard about,” Mr. Trump said. “And you will see something that I think you will really love.” “你听说过的那个新宴会厅，距离完工还有一年，”特朗普说。“到时候你会看到一些我认为你肯定非常喜欢的东西。” Mr. Xi came with gifts. He announced China would be sending two pandas to the Atlanta zoo . 习近平带来了礼物。他宣布 中国将向亚特兰大动物园赠送两只大熊猫。 周三，特朗普前往安德鲁斯联合基地迎接习近平，这打破了总统通常在白宫迎接世界各国领导人的惯例。 In a Truth Social post, Mr. Trump said the day was a made-for-TV moment. But it was missing a crucial component. Major television networks declined to provide shared footage of the events after Mr. Trump blocked CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House. 在Truth Social的一篇帖文中，特朗普称这一天堪称为电视量身定做的时刻。但却缺少了一个关键要素。在特朗普禁止CNN、MS NOW和Politico进入白宫后， 各大电视网拒绝提供这些活动的共享画面。 Reporters from those outlets had their access restored around midday, but the TV pool remained suspended. The networks had indicated that they would not resume coverage following the president until the White House had formally agreed to allow CNN to participate once again in the pool. 这些媒体的记者在中午前后恢复了入场权限，但电视联合采访团仍处于停摆状态。各大电视网曾表示，除非白宫正式同意让CNN再次参与电视联合采访团，否则不会恢复对总统的跟拍报道。 A crowd of Chinese state media workers were, however, allowed onto the White House grounds. 然而，一群中国官方媒体工作人员却被允许进入白宫。 After Mr. Trump’s toast at the state dinner, Mr. Xi selectively recited the history of the two countries, choosing to ignore the worst moments of the Cold War but rather invoke President Richard Nixon’s rapprochement with Beijing in 1972. The message to Trump appeared to be that he, too, had an opportunity to re-establish ties with China, though on Beijing’s terms. 在特朗普于国宴上致祝酒辞后，习近平选择性地回顾了两国的历史，他选择忽略冷战最糟糕的时刻，而是提到理查德·尼克松总统在1972年与北京的破冰和解。这向特朗普传递的信息似乎是，他也有机会重新建立与中国的关系，尽管是按照北京的条件。 “Such a friendship, forged in blood and fire,” he said, “will surely live on through the generations.” “这份血与火锻造的友谊，”习近平说，“必将世代相传。” David E. Sanger、Anton Troianovski、David Pierson、Erica L. Green和储百亮(Chris Buckley)对本文有报道贡献。 Zolan Kanno-Youngs 是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 特朗普的白宫欢迎强人领袖习近平，却拒绝美国记者
description: PETER BAKER2026年9月25日习近平在白宫受到隆重欢迎，但美国的各家电视网却没有报道这一盛况，因为它们仍在抵制白宫记者团。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times At the White House gate, a throng of Chinese journalists was being admitted onto the grounds of the Executive Mansion to cover the visit of President Xi Jinping. Out on the street, several American journalists were blocked from entering the White House on the orders of President Trump. 在白宫门口，一群中国记者正获准进入行政官邸，报道习近平主席的访问。而在外面的街道上，数名美国记者却因特朗普总统的命令无法入内。 The scene on Pennsylvania Avenue on Thursday morning captured a surreal week in the life of Washington. The president of the United States barred American reporters because he labeled them a threat to national security, while welcoming Chinese reporters who answer to the communist dictatorship in Beijing. 周四上午宾夕法尼亚大道上的这一幕捕捉到了华盛顿这一周荒诞离奇的政治现实。美国总统将美国记者拒之门外，称他们是国家安全的威胁，同时却欢迎那些听命于北京共产党独裁政权的中国记者。 This would be the same president who is running government-paid television advertising vowing to stop the United States from becoming socialist or communist in the same week that he held a friendly meeting with the democratic socialist mayor of New York and rolled out a literal red carpet for the communist president of China. The same president who is waging economic war against the prime minister of Canada while inviting the president of Russia to visit his Florida golf club. 同样是这位总统，一边用政府经费投放电视广告，信誓旦旦地宣称要阻止美国变成社会主义或共产主义，一边却在同一周与纽约的民主社会主义市长友好会面，还为中国的这位共产党领导人实实在在地铺上了红地毯。同样也是这位总统，一边对加拿大总理发动经济战，一边却邀请俄罗斯总统访问他位于佛罗里达的高尔夫俱乐部。 周四，中国媒体在白宫外。白宫随行记者团的报道称，当天特朗普总统曾“开玩笑说，中国拥有最友好的记者团”。 In the epic contest between democracy and autocracy, Mr. Trump has long given the impression that he may be on the other side. But rarely has that been brought home as starkly as this week, as he punishes news outlets for being too “negative” about him while embracing Mr. Xi and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia, two of the world’s leading authoritarians whose governments brutally suppress free speech. 在民主与专制这场旷日持久的较量中，特朗普向来给人的印象是，他似乎更倾向于站在专制那一边。但这种印象很少像本周这样赤裸裸地呈现出来：他一边因为新闻机构对自己的报道过于“负面”而惩罚它们，一边却热情拥抱习近平和俄罗斯总统普京——这两位都是世界上主要的威权主义者，其政府残酷压制言论自由。 Mr. Xi’s arrival at the White House was celebrated with pomp and circumstance that were not covered by American television networks, which were still boycotting the White House press pool until Mr. Trump’s staff commits in writing to letting CNN cameras back into the rotation. Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico who were initially barred from entering the White House on Thursday morning despite a court order were allowed in later in the day, but by late afternoon Mr. Trump’s staff had still not permitted CNN back into the pool that provides footage of the president every day. 习近平在白宫受到隆重欢迎，但美国的各家电视网却没有报道这一盛况，因为它们仍在抵制白宫记者团，直到特朗普的工作人员以书面形式承诺让CNN的摄像机重回轮值。周四上午，尽管有法院命令，CNN、MS NOW和Politico的记者起初仍被禁止进入白宫；当天晚些时候，他们获准进入。但截至下午晚些时候，特朗普的工作人员仍未允许CNN重新加入每日拍摄总统日常活动、供各方共享画面的记者团。 Even as Mr. Trump fumed that his carefully orchestrated day of pageantry was not shown on air, he basked in Mr. Xi’s presence and lavished him with praise, making no mention of human rights issues that past presidents raised when meeting with Chinese counterparts. 尽管特朗普对自己精心筹划的这场盛大仪式未能在电视上播出而大为光火，但他仍陶醉于中国领导人的到场，并对其大加赞美，只字未提历任总统在会晤中国领导人时通常都会提及的人权议题。 “From the time of my first election in 2016, President Xi and I have forged a friendship, a truly great friendship, actually, built on mutual respect and the vital interests of our people,” Mr. Trump said in the Grand Foyer of the White House. He later delighted in taking his great friend on a tour of the new White House ballroom that is under construction and showed off his taunting photograph of an autopen meant to represent his predecessor, former President Joseph R. Biden Jr. “自2016年我首次当选以来，我和习主席打造了友谊关系，一段真正伟大的友谊，这段友谊建立在相互尊重和我们的人民的共同利益之上，”特朗普在白宫的主门厅说道。后来，他兴致勃勃地带着这位好友参观正在施工的新白宫宴会厅，还得意地向其展示了一张带有嘲讽意味的照片，照片中是一个自动签名笔，用以影射他的前任拜登总统。 特朗普向习近平展示了一张带有嘲讽意味的照片，照片中是一个自动签名笔，用以影射他的前任拜登总统。 Mr. Trump hopes to similarly host Mr. Putin soon. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced this week that Mr. Trump had invited the once-ostracized Russian leader to attend the annual Group of 20 meeting in Miami in December, which would be his first appearance at the annual gathering since 2019, before his full-fledged invasion of Ukraine. The summit is scheduled to be held at Trump National Doral Miami, where the president tried to host a Group of 7 meeting in his first term only to back down after Republican complaints that it was too self-dealing — complaints not heard this time. 特朗普希望不久后也能以类似方式接待普京。国务卿鲁比奥本周宣布，特朗普已经邀请这位一度遭到国际社会排斥的俄罗斯领导人出席12月在迈阿密举行的二十国集团年度峰会。如果成行，这将是普京自2019年——即其全面入侵乌克兰之前——以来首次出席这一年度聚会。峰会计划在特朗普国家多拉尔迈阿密度假村举行。特朗普第一个任期内曾试图在那里举办七国集团峰会，却因共和党内部批评此举涉嫌以权谋私而作罢，而这一次，这样的抱怨声却没有出现。 While Mr. Putin was kicked out of the G7 and other groups because of his seizure of Crimea in 2014, Mr. Trump has been eager to bring him back into the international fold. The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Mr. Putin on war crimes charges in 2023, but Mr. Trump ignored that by inviting the Russian to Alaska last year — and just this week denounced the court in an address to the U.N. General Assembly as “an evil group of people” as his administration attempts to dismantle the body. 普京因为2014年吞并克里米亚而被逐出七国集团及其他国际组织，但特朗普一直热衷于让他重新融入国际社会。国际刑事法院2023年以战争罪指控对普京发出逮捕令，但特朗普对此置之不理，去年还邀请这位俄罗斯领导人前往阿拉斯加。就在本周，他又在联合国大会发表讲话时斥责该法院是“一群邪恶的人”，而他的政府目前正试图搞垮该机构。 Mr. Trump’s affinity for despots, tyrants and autocrats has baffled democratic leaders and diplomats and reoriented American foreign policy for some 10 years now. He gushes over the likes of Kim Jong-un of North Korea (“we fell in love”), Abdel Fattah el-Sisi of Egypt (“my favorite dictator”), Mohammed bin Salman of Saudi Arabia (“I like him too much”), Recep Tayyip Erdogan of Turkey (“a very good friend of mine”) and Nayib Bukele of El Salvador (“one hell of a president”). 特朗普对独裁者、暴君与威权统治者的亲近，过去大约10年里一直令民主国家的领导人和外交官感到困惑，也重新塑造了美国的外交政策。他对朝鲜的金正恩（“我们坠入了爱河”）、埃及的阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西（“我最喜欢的独裁者”）、沙特阿拉伯的穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼（“我太喜欢他了”）、土耳其的雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安（“我的一个非常好的朋友”）以及萨尔瓦多的纳伊布·布克尔（“一位了不起的总统”）等人赞不绝口。 By contrast, he regularly feuds with leaders of traditional allies like Canada, Britain, France, Germany and Italy. He derided the democratically elected president of Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky, last year as a “dictator without elections” while offering no concerns about Mr. Putin, whose elections have been documented as thoroughly rigged. He had the United States vote along with North Korea, Belarus and Sudan last year against a U.N. resolution condemning Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and lately has been courting Belarus’s dictator Aleksandr G. Lukashenko. 与此形成鲜明对比的是，他时常与加拿大、英国、法国、德国、意大利等传统盟友的领导人爆发争执。去年，他嘲讽乌克兰民选总统泽连斯基是“一个未经选举的独裁者”，却未对普京表达过类似担忧，而后者的历次选举早已被证实为彻头彻尾地舞弊操纵。去年，他曾让美国与朝鲜、白俄罗斯、苏丹一道投票反对一项谴责俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的联合国决议，而最近更是开始向白俄罗斯独裁者亚历山大·卢卡申科示好。 周四，记者团正在等待特朗普和习近平，而各大广播网仍在抵制该记者团，直到特朗普的工作人员以书面形式承诺让CNN的摄像机重回轮值。 At home, Mr. Trump regularly battles the domestic news media, denouncing journalists as “enemies of the people,” a phrase used by Stalin to condemn dissidents to the gulag. More than any American president in modern times, Mr. Trump has mounted a wide-ranging campaign against independent media through multibillion-dollar lawsuits, Federal Communications Commission pressure, subpoenas to reporters, the eviction of The Associated Press from the White House press pool and restrictions that effectively forced reporters out of the Pentagon. 在国内，特朗普经常与美国新闻媒体交战，斥责记者是“人民的敌人”——斯大林曾用这一说法给异见人士定罪，将他们送进古拉格。与现代任何一位美国总统相比，特朗普针对独立媒体发起的打压行动范围都更加广泛，包括索赔数十亿美元的诉讼、通过联邦通信委员会施压、向记者发出传票、将美联社逐出白宫记者团，以及施加实质上迫使记者离开五角大楼的限制措施。 Mr. Trump seemed unbothered on Thursday by any mixed messages sent by welcoming Chinese state reporters at the same time he was trying to throw out American news outlets as part of what he called his “ban on the free press.” On the other hand, he did seem bothered by the fact that the still-unresolved showdown meant that boycotting network television cameras did not beam the festivities to the nation. 周四，特朗普似乎并不在意这样做释放出的矛盾信号：一边欢迎中国官方媒体记者，一边又试图把美国新闻机构赶出去——他把自己的做法称为“对自由媒体的禁令”。不过，另一方面，他似乎的确对这场仍未解决的对峙所造成的结果感到不满：参与抵制的电视网没有用摄像机把这些盛大场面传向全国。 In a social media post late in the day, Mr. Trump praised Mr. Xi as “the Highly Respected President of China” and flattered “his beautiful wife, Madam Peng” while accusing CNN and MS NOW of having “NO CREDIBILITY” and being “Fake News.” A White House pool report indicated that at one point during the day Mr. Trump “made a joke about how the Chinese had the friendliest press corps.” 当天晚些时候，特朗普在社交媒体发帖，称赞习近平是“备受尊敬的中国国家主席”，还恭维“他美丽的妻子彭女士”，与此同时，他指责CNN和MS NOW“毫无公信力”，是“假新闻”。白宫记者团的一篇报道显示，当天特朗普曾“开玩笑说，中国拥有最友好的记者团”。 Which of course depends on the definition of friendly. China exercises iron-fisted control over its press corps and has at least 111 journalists and media workers locked up, according to Reporters Without Borders, making it “the world’s largest prison for journalists.” Of the 180 countries that the group ranks on freedom of the press, China ranks almost at rock bottom at 178th place, above only North Korea and Eritrea. (The United States has fallen to 64th under Mr. Trump.) 当然，这取决于怎么定义“友好”。中国对新闻媒体实行铁腕控制。据无国界记者组织统计，中国至少关押了111名记者和媒体工作者，因此成为“世界上关押记者最多的国家”。在该组织对180个国家的新闻自由度排名中，中国几乎垫底，位列第178名，仅高于朝鲜和厄立特里亚。（特朗普执政下的美国已跌至第64位。） “Trump doesn’t just want to meet with Xi — he wants to copy him,” Senator Chris Coons, Democrat of Delaware and a senior member of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, wrote on social media, citing attacks on the press, politicizing the justice system and purging the civil service. “特朗普不仅仅是想与习近平会面——他还想效仿他，”特拉华州民主党参议员、参议院外交关系委员会资深成员克里斯·库恩斯在社交媒体上写道，并列举了其打压新闻媒体、将司法系统政治化、清洗公务员队伍等种种行径作为佐证。 Even some Republicans, while not openly questioning Mr. Trump’s media ban, expressed disappointment that the president, in courting the leader of one of America’s largest trading partners, was so willing to flatter and fete Mr. Xi while overlooking China’s record of government oppression. 甚至一些共和党人也表达了失望。虽然他们没有公开质疑特朗普针对媒体的禁令，但他们认为，在争取美国最大贸易伙伴之一的领导人时，总统如此乐于奉承、盛情款待习近平，却对中国政府的压迫记录视而不见，令人失望。 “During every minute of dialogue, our commander in chief should keep in mind that his guest is a brutal, unelected and oppressive dictator who seeks to dominate his neighbors and whose massive military arsenal is aimed directly at the United States of America,” said Senator Roger Wicker of Mississippi, the Republican chairman of the Senate Armed Services Committee. “在每一分钟的对话中，我们的三军统帅都应该牢记，他的客人是一名残暴、未经选举产生、实行压迫统治的独裁者，他试图支配邻国，而且其庞大的军事武库直接瞄准美利坚合众国，”密西西比州共和党参议员、参议院军事委员会主席罗杰·威克说。 That was not, however, the message being emphasized at the White House, where the president’s aides this week sought to replace the news outlets he tried to bar by kicking off their own online “Trump TV,” a form of state television that Mr. Xi might recognize. That is certainly one way for Mr. Trump to have his own friendliest press corps. 然而，这并非白宫方面所着力传递的信息。本周，总统的助手们试图通过推出自己的在线“特朗普电视”来取代他试图封杀的新闻媒体——这是习近平可能不会陌生的国家电视台形式。对特朗普来说，这当然是一种拥有属于自己的“最友好记者团”的办法。 Peter Baker是《纽约时报》首席白宫记者。特朗普是他报道的第六任美国总统，有时他也撰写将总统和美国政府置于更宏观的背景和历史框架下的分析性文章。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site
content: PETER BAKER 2026年9月25日 习近平在白宫受到隆重欢迎，但美国的各家电视网却没有报道这一盛况，因为它们仍在抵制白宫记者团。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times At the White House gate, a throng of Chinese journalists was being admitted onto the grounds of the Executive Mansion to cover the visit of President Xi Jinping . Out on the street, several American journalists were blocked from entering the White House on the orders of President Trump. 在白宫门口，一群中国记者正获准进入行政官邸，报道 习近平主席的访问 。而在外面的街道上，数名美国记者却因特朗普总统的命令无法入内。 The scene on Pennsylvania Avenue on Thursday morning captured a surreal week in the life of Washington. The president of the United States barred American reporters because he labeled them a threat to national security, while welcoming Chinese reporters who answer to the communist dictatorship in Beijing. 周四上午宾夕法尼亚大道上的这一幕捕捉到了华盛顿这一周荒诞离奇的政治现实。美国总统将美国记者拒之门外，称他们是国家安全的威胁，同时却欢迎那些听命于北京共产党独裁政权的中国记者。 This would be the same president who is running government-paid television advertising vowing to stop the United States from becoming socialist or communist in the same week that he held a friendly meeting with the democratic socialist mayor of New York and rolled out a literal red carpet for the communist president of China. The same president who is waging economic war against the prime minister of Canada while inviting the president of Russia to visit his Florida golf club. 同样是这位总统，一边 用政府经费投放电视广告 ，信誓旦旦地宣称要阻止美国变成社会主义或共产主义，一边却在同一周与纽约的民主社会主义市长友好会面，还为中国的这位共产党领导人实实在在地铺上了红地毯。同样也是这位总统，一边对加拿大总理发动经济战，一边却邀请俄罗斯总统访问他位于佛罗里达的高尔夫俱乐部。 周四，中国媒体在白宫外。白宫随行记者团的报道称，当天特朗普总统曾“开玩笑说，中国拥有最友好的记者团”。 In the epic contest between democracy and autocracy, Mr. Trump has long given the impression that he may be on the other side. But rarely has that been brought home as starkly as this week, as he punishes news outlets for being too “negative” about him while embracing Mr. Xi and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia, two of the world’s leading authoritarians whose governments brutally suppress free speech. 在民主与专制这场旷日持久的较量中，特朗普向来给人的印象是，他似乎更倾向于站在专制那一边。但这种印象很少像本周这样赤裸裸地呈现出来：他一边因为新闻机构对自己的报道过于“负面”而惩罚它们，一边却热情拥抱习近平和俄罗斯总统普京——这两位都是世界上主要的威权主义者，其政府残酷压制言论自由。 Mr. Xi’s arrival at the White House was celebrated with pomp and circumstance that were not covered by American television networks, which were still boycotting the White House press pool until Mr. Trump’s staff commits in writing to letting CNN cameras back into the rotation. Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico who were initially barred from entering the White House on Thursday morning despite a court order were allowed in later in the day , but by late afternoon Mr. Trump’s staff had still not permitted CNN back into the pool that provides footage of the president every day. 习近平在白宫受到隆重欢迎，但美国的各家电视网却没有报道这一盛况，因为它们仍在 抵制白宫记者团 ，直到特朗普的工作人员以书面形式承诺让CNN的摄像机重回轮值。周四上午，尽管有法院命令，CNN、MS NOW和Politico的记者起初仍被禁止进入白宫； 当天晚些时候，他们获准进入 。但截至下午晚些时候，特朗普的工作人员仍未允许CNN重新加入每日拍摄总统日常活动、供各方共享画面的记者团。 Even as Mr. Trump fumed that his carefully orchestrated day of pageantry was not shown on air, he basked in Mr. Xi’s presence and lavished him with praise, making no mention of human rights issues that past presidents raised when meeting with Chinese counterparts. 尽管特朗普对自己精心筹划的这场盛大仪式未能在电视上播出而大为光火，但他仍陶醉于中国领导人的到场，并对其大加赞美，只字未提历任总统在会晤中国领导人时通常都会提及的人权议题。 “From the time of my first election in 2016, President Xi and I have forged a friendship, a truly great friendship, actually, built on mutual respect and the vital interests of our people,” Mr. Trump said in the Grand Foyer of the White House. He later delighted in taking his great friend on a tour of the new White House ballroom that is under construction and showed off his taunting photograph of an autopen meant to represent his predecessor, former President Joseph R. Biden Jr. “自2016年我首次当选以来，我和习主席打造了友谊关系，一段真正伟大的友谊，这段友谊建立在相互尊重和我们的人民的共同利益之上，”特朗普在白宫的主门厅说道。后来，他兴致勃勃地带着这位好友参观正在施工的新白宫宴会厅，还得意地向其展示了一张带有嘲讽意味的照片，照片中是一个自动签名笔，用以影射他的前任拜登总统。 特朗普向习近平展示了一张带有嘲讽意味的照片，照片中是一个自动签名笔，用以影射他的前任拜登总统。 Mr. Trump hopes to similarly host Mr. Putin soon. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced this week that Mr. Trump had invited the once-ostracized Russian leader to attend the annual Group of 20 meeting in Miami in December, which would be his first appearance at the annual gathering since 2019, before his full-fledged invasion of Ukraine. The summit is scheduled to be held at Trump National Doral Miami, where the president tried to host a Group of 7 meeting in his first term only to back down after Republican complaints that it was too self-dealing — complaints not heard this time. 特朗普希望不久后也能以类似方式接待普京。国务卿鲁比奥 本周宣布 ，特朗普已经邀请这位一度遭到国际社会排斥的俄罗斯领导人出席12月在迈阿密举行的二十国集团年度峰会。如果成行，这将是普京自2019年——即其全面入侵乌克兰之前——以来首次出席这一年度聚会。峰会计划在特朗普国家多拉尔迈阿密度假村举行。特朗普第一个任期内曾试图在那里举办七国集团峰会，却 因共和党内部批评此举涉嫌以权谋私而作罢 ，而这一次，这样的抱怨声却没有出现。 While Mr. Putin was kicked out of the G7 and other groups because of his seizure of Crimea in 2014, Mr. Trump has been eager to bring him back into the international fold. The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Mr. Putin on war crimes charges in 2023, but Mr. Trump ignored that by inviting the Russian to Alaska last year — and just this week denounced the court in an address to the U.N. General Assembly as “an evil group of people” as his administration attempts to dismantle the body. 普京因为2014年吞并克里米亚而被逐出七国集团及其他国际组织，但特朗普一直热衷于让他重新融入国际社会。国际刑事法院2023年以战争罪指控对普京发出逮捕令，但特朗普对此置之不理，去年还邀请这位俄罗斯领导人前往阿拉斯加。就在本周，他又在联合国大会发表讲话时斥责该法院是“一群邪恶的人”，而他的政府目前正试图搞垮该机构。 Mr. Trump’s affinity for despots, tyrants and autocrats has baffled democratic leaders and diplomats and reoriented American foreign policy for some 10 years now. He gushes over the likes of Kim Jong-un of North Korea (“we fell in love”), Abdel Fattah el-Sisi of Egypt (“my favorite dictator”), Mohammed bin Salman of Saudi Arabia (“I like him too much”), Recep Tayyip Erdogan of Turkey (“a very good friend of mine”) and Nayib Bukele of El Salvador (“one hell of a president”). 特朗普对独裁者、暴君与威权统治者的亲近，过去大约10年里一直令民主国家的领导人和外交官感到困惑，也重新塑造了美国的外交政策。他对朝鲜的金正恩（“我们坠入了爱河”）、埃及的阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西（“我最喜欢的独裁者”）、沙特阿拉伯的穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼（“我太喜欢他了”）、土耳其的雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安（“我的一个非常好的朋友”）以及萨尔瓦多的纳伊布·布克尔（“一位了不起的总统”）等人赞不绝口。 By contrast, he regularly feuds with leaders of traditional allies like Canada, Britain, France, Germany and Italy. He derided the democratically elected president of Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky, last year as a “dictator without elections” while offering no concerns about Mr. Putin, whose elections have been documented as thoroughly rigged. He had the United States vote along with North Korea, Belarus and Sudan last year against a U.N. resolution condemning Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and lately has been courting Belarus’s dictator Aleksandr G. Lukashenko. 与此形成鲜明对比的是，他时常与加拿大、英国、法国、德国、意大利等传统盟友的领导人爆发争执。去年，他嘲讽乌克兰民选总统泽连斯基是“一个未经选举的独裁者”，却未对普京表达过类似担忧，而后者的历次选举早已被证实为彻头彻尾地舞弊操纵。去年，他曾让美国与朝鲜、白俄罗斯、苏丹一道 投票反对 一项谴责俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的联合国决议，而最近更是开始 向白俄罗斯独裁者亚历山大·卢卡申科示好 。 周四，记者团正在等待特朗普和习近平，而各大广播网仍在抵制该记者团，直到特朗普的工作人员以书面形式承诺让CNN的摄像机重回轮值。 At home, Mr. Trump regularly battles the domestic news media, denouncing journalists as “enemies of the people,” a phrase used by Stalin to condemn dissidents to the gulag. More than any American president in modern times, Mr. Trump has mounted a wide-ranging campaign against independent media through multibillion-dollar lawsuits, Federal Communications Commission pressure, subpoenas to reporters, the eviction of The Associated Press from the White House press pool and restrictions that effectively forced reporters out of the Pentagon. 在国内，特朗普经常与美国新闻媒体交战，斥责记者是“人民的敌人”——斯大林曾用这一说法给异见人士定罪，将他们送进古拉格。与现代任何一位美国总统相比，特朗普针对独立媒体发起的打压行动范围都更加广泛，包括索赔数十亿美元的诉讼、通过联邦通信委员会施压、向记者发出传票、将美联社逐出白宫记者团，以及施加实质上迫使记者离开五角大楼的限制措施。 Mr. Trump seemed unbothered on Thursday by any mixed messages sent by welcoming Chinese state reporters at the same time he was trying to throw out American news outlets as part of what he called his “ban on the free press.” On the other hand, he did seem bothered by the fact that the still-unresolved showdown meant that boycotting network television cameras did not beam the festivities to the nation. 周四，特朗普似乎并不在意这样做释放出的矛盾信号：一边欢迎中国官方媒体记者，一边又试图把美国新闻机构赶出去——他把自己的做法称为“对自由媒体的禁令”。不过，另一方面，他似乎的确对这场仍未解决的对峙所造成的结果感到不满：参与抵制的电视网没有用摄像机把这些盛大场面传向全国。 In a social media post late in the day, Mr. Trump praised Mr. Xi as “the Highly Respected President of China” and flattered “his beautiful wife, Madam Peng” while accusing CNN and MS NOW of having “NO CREDIBILITY” and being “Fake News.” A White House pool report indicated that at one point during the day Mr. Trump “made a joke about how the Chinese had the friendliest press corps.” 当天晚些时候，特朗普在社交媒体 发帖 ，称赞习近平是“备受尊敬的中国国家主席”，还恭维“他美丽的妻子彭女士”，与此同时，他指责CNN和MS NOW“毫无公信力”，是“假新闻”。白宫记者团的一篇 报道 显示，当天特朗普曾“开玩笑说，中国拥有最友好的记者团”。 Which of course depends on the definition of friendly. China exercises iron-fisted control over its press corps and has at least 111 journalists and media workers locked up, according to Reporters Without Borders , making it “the world’s largest prison for journalists.” Of the 180 countries that the group ranks on freedom of the press, China ranks almost at rock bottom at 178th place, above only North Korea and Eritrea. (The United States has fallen to 64th under Mr. Trump.) 当然，这取决于怎么定义“友好”。中国对新闻媒体实行铁腕控制。据 无国界记者组织 统计，中国至少关押了111名记者和媒体工作者，因此成为“世界上关押记者最多的国家”。在该组织对180个国家的新闻自由度排名中，中国几乎垫底，位列第178名，仅高于朝鲜和厄立特里亚。（特朗普执政下的美国已跌至第64位。） “Trump doesn’t just want to meet with Xi — he wants to copy him,” Senator Chris Coons, Democrat of Delaware and a senior member of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, wrote on social media , citing attacks on the press, politicizing the justice system and purging the civil service. “特朗普不仅仅是想与习近平会面——他还想效仿他，”特拉华州民主党参议员、参议院外交关系委员会资深成员克里斯·库恩斯 在社交媒体上写道 ，并列举了其打压新闻媒体、将司法系统政治化、清洗公务员队伍等种种行径作为佐证。 Even some Republicans, while not openly questioning Mr. Trump’s media ban, expressed disappointment that the president, in courting the leader of one of America’s largest trading partners, was so willing to flatter and fete Mr. Xi while overlooking China’s record of government oppression. 甚至一些共和党人也表达了失望。虽然他们没有公开质疑特朗普针对媒体的禁令，但他们认为，在争取美国最大贸易伙伴之一的领导人时，总统如此乐于奉承、盛情款待习近平，却对中国政府的压迫记录视而不见，令人失望。 “During every minute of dialogue, our commander in chief should keep in mind that his guest is a brutal, unelected and oppressive dictator who seeks to dominate his neighbors and whose massive military arsenal is aimed directly at the United States of America,” said Senator Roger Wicker of Mississippi, the Republican chairman of the Senate Armed Services Committee. “在每一分钟的对话中，我们的三军统帅都应该牢记，他的客人是一名残暴、未经选举产生、实行压迫统治的独裁者，他试图支配邻国，而且其庞大的军事武库直接瞄准美利坚合众国，”密西西比州共和党参议员、参议院军事委员会主席 罗杰·威克 说。 That was not, however, the message being emphasized at the White House, where the president’s aides this week sought to replace the news outlets he tried to bar by kicking off their own online “Trump TV,” a form of state television that Mr. Xi might recognize. That is certainly one way for Mr. Trump to have his own friendliest press corps. 然而，这并非白宫方面所着力传递的信息。本周，总统的助手们试图通过推出自己的在线“特朗普电视”来取代他试图封杀的新闻媒体——这是习近平可能不会陌生的国家电视台形式。对特朗普来说，这当然是一种拥有属于自己的“最友好记者团”的办法。 Peter Baker 是《纽约时报》首席白宫记者。特朗普是他报道的第六任美国总统，有时他也撰写将总统和美国政府置于更宏观的背景和历史框架下的分析性文章。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: “习特会”国宴菜单：芝麻脆皮海鲈鱼和爽脆嫩白菜
description: LEO SANDS2026年9月25日特朗普总统将于周四晚为中国国家主席习近平举行国宴。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times President Trump and the first lady, Melania Trump, are preparing to host President Xi Jinping of China for a state dinner in the East Room of the White House on Thursday evening. 特朗普总统与第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普正准备于周四晚在白宫东厅为中国国家主席习近平举行国宴。 According to the three-course menu released by the White House, the dishes were chosen to emphasize American ingredients with a “subtle Chinese influence.” 根据白宫公布的三道菜菜单，菜品的选择主要展示美国食材，同时“巧妙融入中国元素”。 Chefs will serve Mr. Trump, Mr. Xi and other guests a main course of sesame-crusted sea bass and crisp baby bok choy. The yellow squash appetizer will be drizzled with scallion oil. According to the White House, the dishes bring “the culinary traditions of both nations together.” 厨师将为特朗普、习近平和其他宾客奉上一道以芝麻脆皮海鲈鱼和爽脆嫩白菜为主的主菜。作为前菜的黄南瓜浓汤将淋上葱油。白宫称，这些菜品将“两国的烹饪传统融为一体”。 The East Room tables will be laid with red linens and its urns filled with red blossoms, which the administration said was a reference to the color’s significance in China. “The décor for the evening is an expression of warmth and celebration,” it said. 东厅的餐桌将铺上红色桌布，花器也将插满红花。政府表示，这一布置是为了呼应红色在中国文化中的特殊意义。“当晚的装饰体现了热情与喜庆的氛围，”白宫表示。 Diners will begin their meal by toasting with a glass of Schramsberg. That is the California sparkling wine that President Richard M. Nixon drank in 1972 during his visit to Beijing, which heralded a historic thaw in U.S.-Chinese relations. 晚宴将以世酿伯格酒庄的气泡酒祝酒开场。1972年，尼克松总统访问北京时喝的正是这款加州起泡酒。那次访问开启了美中关系历史性的破冰。 First Course 第一道菜 Yellow squash velouté 黄南瓜浓汤 Wild mushroom fricassee 野菇烩菜 Crispy pancetta 香脆意式培根 Scallion oil 香葱油 Second Course 第二道菜 Sesame-crusted sea bass 芝麻脆皮海鲈鱼 Braised baby bok choy 炖嫩白菜 Roasted garden eggplant 烤园圃茄子 Sauce verte 青酱 Dessert 甜点 Vanilla crémeux and White House honey ice cream 香草奶油慕斯配白宫蜂蜜冰淇淋 Walnut frangipane 核桃杏仁奶油饼 Sour cherry confit 酸樱桃果酱 Entertainment 表演 The opera singer Christopher Macchio, who performed this month at the Republican midterm convention in Dallas, will headline the evening’s musical lineup. 男高音歌唱家克里斯托弗·马基奥将领衔当晚的音乐演出。本月，他曾在达拉斯举行的共和党中期选举大会上献唱。 Musicians from the U.S. Army and Marine Corps will also perform. 美国陆军和海军陆战队的的军乐团也将献演。 Leo Sands是《纽约时报》突发新闻中心记者，常驻伦敦。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

Nixon drank in 1972 during his visit to Beijing, which heralded a historic thaw in U.S.-Chinese relations. 晚宴将以世酿伯格酒庄的气泡酒祝酒开场。1972年，尼克松总统访问北京时喝的正是这款加州起泡酒。那次访问开启了美中关系历史性的破冰。 First Course 第一道菜 Yellow squash velouté 黄南瓜浓汤 Wild mushroom fricassee 野菇烩菜 Crispy pancetta 香脆意式培根 Scallion oil 香葱油 Second Course 第二道菜 Sesame-crusted sea bass 芝麻脆皮海鲈鱼 Braised baby bok choy 炖嫩白菜 Roasted garden eggplant 烤园圃茄子 Sauce verte 青酱 Dessert 甜点 Vanilla crémeux and White House honey ice cream 香草奶油慕斯配白宫蜂蜜冰淇淋 Walnut frangipane 核桃杏仁奶油饼 Sour cherry confit 酸樱桃果酱 Entertainment 表演 The opera singer Christopher Macchio, who performed this month at the Republican midterm convention in Dallas, will headline the evening’s musical lineup. 男高音歌唱家克里斯托弗·马基奥将领衔当晚的音乐演出。本月，他曾在达拉斯举行的共和党中期选举大会上献唱。 Musicians from the U.S. Army and Marine Corps will also perform. 美国陆军和海军陆战队的的军乐团也将献演。 Leo Sands 是《纽约时报》突发新闻中心记者，常驻伦敦。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 特朗普与习近平在白宫会面，外界对峰会成果预期较低
description: ZOLAN KANNO-YOUNGS, DAVID E. SANGER, ANTON TROIANOVSKI2026年9月25日 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times President Trump greeted President Xi Jinping of China at a lavish White House arrival ceremony on Thursday morning, with the two leaders striking different tones in their opening remarks at a landmark U.S.-China summit that is likely to be full of pomp but unlikely to produce significant agreements. 周四上午，特朗普总统在一场奢华的白宫欢迎仪式上迎接中国国家主席习近平。这场具有里程碑意义的美中元首峰会可能充满盛大仪式，却不太可能达成重大协议，两位领导人在开场致辞中展现出截然不同的基调。 Mr. Trump emphasized the “truly great friendship” between the two leaders after they and their spouses met on a red carpet outside the White House. Mr. Xi’s opening remarks were less personal: The Chinese leader thanked the Trumps for their hospitality before turning to matters of geopolitics, including Chinese companies’ access to the United States. 在两位领导人及夫人在白宫外的红毯会面后，特朗普强调了两人之间“真正伟大的友谊”。习近平的开场致辞则没有那么个人化：这位中国领导人感谢了特朗普夫妇的盛情款待，随后转向地缘政治问题，包括中国企业进入美国市场等问题。 “The interests of China and the United States are deeply intertwined,” Mr. Xi said. The two nations, he said, must avoid the “Thucydides trap” — the theory that a rising power and an established power are likely to go to war. “中美两国利益深度交融，”习近平说。他表示，两国必须避免“修昔底德陷阱”——即新兴大国和老牌强国可能会爆发战争的理论。 Mr. Xi also announced that his country would be sending two pandas to the Atlanta zoo in the coming days as he invoked Mr. Trump’s oft-used slogan: “Achieving the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and making America great again can go hand in hand.” 习近平还宣布，中国将在未来几天向亚特兰大动物园送去两只大熊猫，他还引用了特朗普经常使用的口号，称“实现中华民族伟大复兴和让美国再次伟大并行不悖”。 The White House visit, Mr. Xi’s first in more than a decade, opened with elaborate ceremonies involving hundreds of U.S. military personnel and a B-2 stealth bomber flyover. On Thursday evening, Mr. Trump is set to host a state dinner in Mr. Xi’s honor. 这次白宫之行是习近平十余年来的首次到访，行程以精心设计的仪式拉开帷幕，数百名美国军人参与欢迎仪式，一架B-2隐形轰炸机飞越现场。周四晚间，特朗普将为习近平举办国宴。 But expectations are low for breakthroughs in resolving any of the major tensions between the world’s two most powerful countries. Those include a shaky trade-war truce, the fate of Taiwan, a risky A.I. race and China’s support for Iran and for Russia’s war against Ukraine. 但对于这两个世界上最强大国家能否在任何重大矛盾方面取得突破，外界的期望并不高。其中包括不稳定的贸易战休战、台湾的命运、人工智能竞争的风险，以及中国对伊朗以及俄罗斯战争的支持。 In a sign of the incremental nature of the two countries’ negotiations, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said late Wednesday that the United States and China had agreed to extend a one-year trade truce by two months, to Jan. 10. It had been due to expire Nov. 10. 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特于周三晚间表示，美中已同意将为期一年的贸易停火协议延长两个月，至1月10日。该协议原定于11月10日到期。这体现了两国之间谈判的渐进性质。 Nor do experts expect much headway on artificial intelligence safety issues, despite American complaints about Chinese A.I. practices and even though some of America’s biggest tech titans have been invited to the dinner Thursday. 尽管美国对中国的人工智能行业做法有所抱怨，但专家们也不认为两国会在人工智能安全问题上取得太大进展。尽管一些美国最大的科技巨头已被邀请参加周四的晚宴。 Mr. Xi, for his part, could take advantage of Mr. Trump’s efforts to maintain a good relationship by pressing him to continue delaying arms sales to Taiwan. 就习近平而言，他可能会利用特朗普维护良好关系的努力向其施压，要求他继续推迟对台湾的军售。 Here’s what else to know: 以下是其他需要了解的内容： • First lady: Melania Trump is scheduled to take Mr. Xi’s wife, Peng Liyuan, to the Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art after Thursday’s arrival ceremony. On Friday, the women will join their husbands for tea in the Red Room of the White House and for a tour of the National Archives. • 第一夫人：梅拉尼娅·特朗普计划在周四的欢迎仪式后陪同习近平的夫人彭丽媛前往史密森尼国家亚洲艺术博物馆。周五，两位夫人将陪同他们的丈夫在白宫红厅共进下午茶，并参观国家档案馆。 • Americans detained: The families of two Americans listed by the U.S. government as wrongfully detained in China are urging Mr. Trump to press Mr. Xi for their release. They are Youlin Chen, a seismologist who was detained and accused of spying while visiting relatives in Beijing in 2024, and U Min Zin, a political scientist who was arrested in June while visiting southwest China to attend a conference at the invitation of the Chinese government. • 被拘押的美国人：被美国政府列为在中国被错误拘押的两名美国人的家属正敦促特朗普向习近平施压，促成他们的释放。两人分别是陈友麟，一位于2024年在北京探亲时被拘押并被指控从事间谍活动的地质学家；以及敏辛，一位于6月受中国政府邀请前往中国西南地区参加会议时被逮捕的政治学家。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 关于人工智能安全，中国真正在乎的是什么
description: 高安西2026年9月24日 If there is one person who represents the frontier of Chinese artificial intelligence, it is Tang Jie. 如果要说谁代表了中国人工智能的前沿，那就是唐杰。 The soft-spoken data engineer is the co-founder, chief scientist and largest individual shareholder of China’s leading artificial intelligence lab, Z.ai, whose models have risen to the top tier of China’s performance tables and made Mr. Tang the flag-bearer for the Chinese A.I. ecosystem. 这位文质彬彬的数据工程师是中国顶尖人工智能实验室智谱AI(Z.ai)的联合创始人、首席科学家兼最大个人股东。智谱AI旗下模型的性能已跃升至中国第一梯队，也让唐杰成为了中国人工智能生态系统的领军人物。 In some ways, Mr. Tang’s messaging about A.I. seems to mirror that of Dario Amodei, the co-founder and chief executive of Anthropic — the American company behind Claude — and one of the most prominent voices extolling A.I.’s promise while warning of its risks. Mr. Tang pairs an almost utopian excitement with what he has called the “heaviest responsibility” of “extreme safety governance.” 在某种程度上，唐杰关于人工智能的表态似乎与达里奥·阿莫迪遥相呼应。阿莫迪是Claude背后的美国公司Anthropic的联合创始人兼首席执行官，也是行业内既赞美人工智能前景又警告其风险的代表性人物。唐杰将一种近乎乌托邦式的热情与他所称的“极致安全治理”这一“最重的责任”结合在了一起。 “Once a technology reaches a magnitude of power sufficient to alter the course of civilization, safety is no longer an accessory, but the fundamental precondition for that technology to survive and to be permitted for use,” Mr. Tang said in a letter to staff that was leaked to the Chinese media in July. “当一项技术抵达足以改变文明进程的力量量级时，安全就不再是附属品，而是技术得以存续与被允许应用的根本前提，”唐杰在7月曝光的一封致员工的信中这样写道。 Those words may sound strikingly similar to warnings now coming from leading American A.I. labs. But they are better understood through the language of President Xi Jinping of China, for whom A.I. “safety” is ultimately bound to one overriding concern: the security of the Chinese Communist Party regime. 这些话听起来或许与美国顶尖人工智能实验室发出的预警惊人地相似。但若结合中国国家主席习近平的语境来理解，其含义会更加清晰——对习近平而言，人工智能“安全”归根结底指向一个核心关切：中国共产党政权的安全。 While the debate in Western capitals has centered on the dangers A.I. poses to society, the animating concern in China is the threat it poses to the state. Chinese models are already well known for filtering or avoiding politically sensitive information in ways that reflect state censorship. But developers like Mr. Tang are going further, working to embed Communist Party orthodoxy deeply into the models, with potentially far-reaching implications for the values and vulnerabilities that Chinese A.I. systems bring with them. 西方多国政府将辩论焦点放在人工智能对社会构成的危险上，中国最关切的则是其对国家政权构成的威胁。中国模型因过滤或规避政治敏感信息以契合国家审查制度而广为人知。但像唐杰这样的开发者正走得更远，他们致力于将执政党意识形态深刻植入模型底层，这对中国人工智能系统所携带的价值观及其潜在脆弱性具有深远影响。 Recognizing these diverging views on the technology that will shape the next century is crucial in setting expectations for the talks on Thursday between President Trump and Mr. Xi at the White House. The leaders are set to discuss how to mitigate A.I. risks. Arriving at meaningful cooperation will be difficult — if not impossible — because there are two almost entirely unrelated conversations about what A.I. safety means happening on opposite sides of the Pacific. 认清对这项将塑造下个世纪的关键技术的理念分歧对于设定特朗普与习近平周四在白宫会谈的预期至关重要。两国领导人准备讨论如何规避人工智能风险。然而，要达成实质性合作将极其困难，甚至难以实现，因为太平洋两岸对于“人工智能安全”的理解完全是两套互不相干的语境。 The wider stakes are potentially enormous. Mr. Tang and his colleagues are instilling values into their models that shape how they interpret the world and respond. As Chinese A.I. is increasingly being adopted globally, those values could travel with it, quietly carrying the Communist Party’s worldview far beyond Chinese shores. 这背后的影响可能是巨大的。唐杰和他的同事正向模型注入特定价值观，从而塑造模型理解世界与做出回应的方式。随着中国人工智能系统在全球范围内得到越来越广泛的应用，这些价值观也可能随之传播，悄然将执政党的世界观带到远超中国本土的地方。 Six days after Mr. Tang’s letter to Z.ai’s staff, Mr. Xi provided a glimpse into his thinking when he convened the annual World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai on July 17. In comments translated into English by state-run media, Mr. Xi was quoted as saying that “China lays great emphasis on safety and security in A.I.” and is committed to keeping it “safe, secure and controllable.” It seemed a reassuring signal ahead of the scheduled talks with Mr. Trump. 在唐杰发表致智谱员工信六天后，习近平于7月17日在上海出席年度世界人工智能大会时，展现了他的思考方向。在由官方媒体翻译成英文的表述中，习近平表示“China lays great emphasis on safety and security in A.I.”（中国高度重视人工智能的安全和保障），并致力于确保其“safe, secure and controllable”（安全、稳固和可控）。在与特朗普预定的会谈前夕，这似乎释放出了一个令人放心的信号。 But Chinese state media often translates comments by the country’s leaders in ways that soften their political meaning for foreign audiences. What Mr. Xi actually said in Chinese was that China’s emphasis was on “development and security,” and on making sure “A.I. is secure, reliable and controllable.” 然而，中国官方媒体在翻译领导人讲话时，往往会面向外国受众软化其政治含义。习近平中文讲话的原话是：中国坚持“发展和安全”并重，确保“人工智能安全、可靠、可控”。 That may seem like a fine distinction in translation. But in Mr. Xi’s vocabulary, words like “security” and “control” ultimately refer to the political security of the Communist Party. Time and again, Mr. Xi has made clear that ensuring China’s Communist system endures in a rapidly changing world is at the heart of his agenda. 这在翻译上或许看似只是微小的差别。但在习近平的语汇体系中，“安全”与“控制”等词汇归根结底指的是执政党的政治安全。他多次明确强调，确保中国的社会主义制度在快速变化的世界中稳固长久是他施政的核心议题。 Today’s Silicon Valley pioneers grew up in a liberal democracy, consuming science fiction in which man builds machines that promise utopia but might ultimately destroy him. Mr. Amodei’s essay in January on A.I. risks, “The Adolescence of Technology,” opens with a scene from one of his favorite films, “Contact.” The protagonist, played by Jodie Foster, is asked what she will say to the advanced life form that has established radio contact from outer space. 如今的硅谷先行者成长于自由民主社会，从小接触的科幻作品多描绘人类怀着建设乌托邦的本意，却创造了可能最终毁灭人类的机器。在今年1月发表的关于人工智能风险的文章《技术的青春期》中，阿莫迪开篇引用了他最喜欢的电影之一《超时空接触》(Contact)的场景：由朱迪·福斯特饰演的女主角被问及，她想对来自外太空并建立起无线电联系的高级智慧生命说些什么。 She replies: “How did you do it? How did you evolve? How did you survive this technological adolescence without destroying yourself?” 她回答道：“你们是怎么做到的？你们是如何演化的？你们是如何度过这个技术青春期而没有毁灭自己的？” The essay details how to manage the potentially catastrophic risks inherent in the technology that Mr. Amodei is helping build, including by baking safety principles into A.I. so they are inseparable from the model itself. Known as constitutional A.I., this method attempts to teach the technology what it means to be “a good A.I.” at the level of character, values and personality — “like a child forming their identity,” Mr. Amodei wrote. 该文详细阐述了如何管理阿莫迪参与构建的技术所固有的灾难性风险，其中包括将安全原则融入人工智能，使其与模型本身密不可分。这种被称为“宪制人工智能”(constitutional A.I.)的方法，试图在性格、价值观和品格层面教授这项技术何为“合格的人工智能”——“就像一个正在形成自身认同的孩子，”阿莫迪写道。 The values that Anthropic instills in its models borrow from the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and are weighted heavily toward access to information, rule of law, political freedom, self-determination and individual liberty. Anthropic注入其模型中的价值观借鉴了《世界人权宣言》，高度侧重于信息获取、法治、政治自由、自决权和个人自由。 Similarly, Demis Hassabis, the co-founder and chairman of Google DeepMind, has developed a set of A.I. principles explicitly anchored in liberal democratic values and argues that democracies should lead in A.I. development, “guided by core values like freedom, equality, and respect for human rights.” 无独有偶，Google DeepMind联合创始人兼主席德米斯·哈萨比斯也制定了一套明确锚定于自由民主价值观的人工智能原则，并主张民主国家应当在“自由、平等和尊重人权等核心价值观的指引下”引领人工智能的发展。 China’s new generation of tech leaders has been brought up in an altogether different environment, an authoritarian world where liberal values are labeled hostile to China and technology is developed and controlled for the benefit of the Communist Party. 中国的新一代科技领袖则成长于截然不同的环境——在一个威权体系中，自由主义价值观被标记为对华敌对，技术的开发与管控完全服务于执政党的利益。 Mr. Xi’s minister for state security, Chen Yixin, made that clear in an essay published this month on the dangers of A.I. Mr. Chen made no mention of the existential threat of artificial intelligence turning against its masters, the fear that preoccupies leading American A.I. figures. Instead, he said China needed to raise its defenses against hostile human forces that would use this powerful new tool for a “direct assault on our political security, institutional security, and ideological security.” 习近平任命的国家安全部部长陈一新在本月发表的一篇关于人工智能风险的文章中清晰阐明了这一点。陈一新完全没有提及困扰美国人工智能领军人物的生存威胁，即人工智能失控反噬人类的恐惧。相反，他强调中国必须加强防御敌对势力，防止其利用这一强大工具“直接威胁我政治安全、制度安全、意识形态安全”。 A.I. safety, in Mr. Chen’s telling, lies in aggressively pushing forward the development of Chinese artificial intelligence so that it does not fall behind the United States, a prospect that he implied posed the technology’s biggest danger for China. The country’s evolving A.I. regulatory system also places threats to socialist values, state power and political stability among the government’s core safety concerns. 在陈一新的论述中，人工智能的安全在于大力推进中国人工智能的发展，以防落后于美国，他暗示这种落后才是该技术对中国构成的最大危险。中国不断完善的人工智能监管体系也将对社会主义价值观、国家权力和政治稳定的威胁列为政府的核心安全关切。 Very little personal information is known about Mr. Tang, who rarely speaks publicly. He formed Z.ai by joining together with other members of the Knowledge Engineering Group, a research unit at Beijing’s prestigious Tsinghua University. The group developed sophisticated tools for analyzing social networks and information flows, including systems for profiling and locating researchers in China and other countries and mapping their relationships, which were presented as recruiting tools. 外界对极少公开发言的唐杰个人信息知之甚少。他联合北京名校清华大学的知识工程实验室其他成员共同创立了智谱AI。该团队曾开发出用于分析社交网络和信息流的先进工具，包括用于对国内外研究人员进行画像、定位及绘制关系图谱的系统，它们被定位为人才招聘工具。 In Mr. Tang’s July letter, he rejected the idea of “bolt-on” safety patches for A.I., saying instead that behavioral principles must be embedded in the foundations of the company’s models, including writing Chinese national laws, strategy and security concerns — in other words, the Communist Party’s political interests — into the A.I.’s basic DNA. In August, Mr. Tang went a step further, publishing a commentary that argued in favor of laws to impose ideological conformity on the Chinese artificial intelligence industry. 唐杰在7月的一封信中，拒绝了对人工智能采取“外挂式”安全补丁的做法，而是主张必须将行为准则植入公司模型的底层架构中，包括将国家法律、战略与安全关切——换言之，即执政党的政治利益——写入人工智能的基础基因。8月，唐杰更进一步，发表了一篇评论文章，主张通过立法对中国人工智能产业强制实施意识形态的一致性。 Last month, his company released one of China’s most powerful A.I. models, GLM-5.3 — which Z.ai markets as a cheap, accessible and capable open-weight cyberdefense tool approaching the abilities of Mythos 5, Anthropic’s powerful cybersecurity model. Users can download and modify open-weight models, fine-tuning them for specific tasks, though deeply embedded behaviors may be difficult to strip out. Z.ai argues that advanced tools like these should be made widely available to developers and cybersecurity teams around the world, an approach that contrasts with the more closely guarded proprietary models of Anthropic and OpenAI. 上个月，他的公司发布了中国最强大的AI模型之一GLM-5.3。智谱AI将其定位为一款廉价、易获取且功能强大的开源权重网络防御工具，其性能已接近Anthropic强大的网络安全模型Mythos 5。用户可以下载并修改开源权重模型，针对特定任务进行微调，尽管其中深度嵌入的行为可能难以彻底清除。智谱AI主张将这类先进工具向全球开发者和网络安全团队开放，这一路线与Anthropic和OpenAI严格保密的闭源专有模型形成了鲜明对比。 Despite Mr. Tang’s rhetoric of openness, Z.ai has otherwise offered little transparency into how its models are trained and evaluated. And Chinese citizens, business and other entities are subject to a National Intelligence Law that obliges them to support state intelligence work when called upon. Z.ai’s financial reports state that vulnerabilities uncovered by its models are submitted to Chinese authorities, including the National Vulnerability Database, which collects and analyzes information on cybersecurity flaws. The database is managed by Mr. Chen’s Ministry of State Security. 尽管唐杰高调宣传开放，智谱AI在模型训练和评估方式方面却几乎没有透明度。此外，中国公民、企业及其他实体均须遵守《国家情报法》，该法规定他们有义务在接到要求时配合国家情报工作。智谱AI的财务报告显示，其模型发现的安全漏洞会提交给中国当局，包括收集和分析网络安全缺陷信息的国家安全漏洞数据库。而该数据库正是由陈一新主管的国家安全部负责管理。 This raises a troubling question, especially as use of Chinese open-weight models spreads overseas: When Z.ai finds a dangerous flaw, who learns about it first — the company that needs to fix it, or the Chinese state? 这引发了一个令人不安的疑问，尤其是在中国开放式模型在海外广泛应用的背景下：如果智谱AI发现一个危险的安全漏洞，究竟谁会首先获知——是需要修复该漏洞的公司，还是中国政府？ Researchers at leading American A.I. labs and government agencies in Washington and allied capitals are already voicing growing concern over the potential threat from “sleeper agents” — malicious hidden instructions that can be planted in A.I. models and remain dormant until triggered, making them difficult to detect or remove. Those dangers are amplified by newer “agentic” A.I., which is often given greater and more autonomous access to computer systems. 美国顶尖人工智能实验室的研究人员，以及美国与盟友国家的政府机构，已经对“潜伏特工”(sleeper agents)带来的潜在威胁表达日益强烈的担忧。这类恶意隐藏指令可以预先植入人工智能模型中，保持潜伏状态，直至被特定条件触发，极难被检测或清除。而随着具有更高自主权限、可直接访问计算机系统的“智能体式”人工智能的发展，这种危险被进一步放大。 All of these things underscore the pressing need for the United States and China to find common ground on A.I. — and, at the same time, why that will prove exceedingly difficult. 所有这一切都凸显出美中两国在人工智能领域寻求共识的紧迫性——但同时也说明了为什么达成共识将极其困难。 The Communist Party’s obsession with gaining an advantage over the United States and prioritizing regime security leaves little room for agreement on the catastrophic risks of A.I. Mr. Trump, too, seems to feel strategic competition outweighs the danger of unchecked A.I. development, recently dismissing the need for regulation in public comments and on social media. 中共执着于在与美国的竞争中取得优势，并将政权安全置于首位，这令双方几乎没有就人工智能的灾难性风险达成共识的空间。而特朗普似乎也认为，战略竞争的重要性超过了不受约束的人工智能发展所带来的危险，他最近在公开讲话中和社交媒体上均对监管的必要性持否定态度。 Trump’s free-market attitude misses the larger contest taking shape. The race over A.I. is no longer only about technological superiority. It is also a contest over whose concepts of freedom, security and the role of the state become embedded in the powerful systems that are increasingly shaping how societies think, make decisions and wield power. 特朗普这种自由市场的态度忽视了正在形成的更大博弈。围绕人工智能的竞赛已不仅仅关乎技术领先地位，更是双方关于自由、安全以及国家角色等理念的角逐。胜出的理念将被融入日益深刻地塑造社会思维方式、决策过程和权力运作方式的强大系统之中。 图片来源：Alex Wong/Getty Images 高安西(John Garnaut)是地缘政治风险咨询公司Garnaut Global的创始人。他曾任《悉尼先驱晨报》驻华记者及澳大利亚前总理麦肯·腾博的高级顾问，著有《薄氏家族的陨落》(The Fall of the House of Bo)。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site
content: 高安西 2026年9月24日 If there is one person who represents the frontier of Chinese artificial intelligence, it is Tang Jie . 如果要说谁代表了中国人工智能的前沿，那就是 唐杰 。 The soft-spoken data engineer is the co-founder, chief scientist and largest individual shareholder of China’s leading artificial intelligence lab, Z.ai, whose models have risen to the top tier of China’s performance tables and made Mr. Tang the flag-bearer for the Chinese A.I. ecosystem. 这位文质彬彬的数据工程师是中国顶尖人工智能实验室智谱AI(Z.ai)的联合创始人、首席科学家兼最大个人股东。智谱AI旗下模型的性能已 跃升 至中国第一梯队，也让唐杰成为了中国人工智能生态系统的领军人物。 In some ways, Mr. Tang’s messaging about A.I. seems to mirror that of Dario Amodei, the co-founder and chief executive of Anthropic — the American company behind Claude — and one of the most prominent voices extolling A.I.’s promise while warning of its risks. Mr. Tang pairs an almost utopian excitement with what he has called the “heaviest responsibility” of “extreme safety governance.” 在某种程度上，唐杰关于人工智能的表态似乎与达里奥·阿莫迪遥相呼应。阿莫迪是Claude背后的美国公司Anthropic的联合创始人兼首席执行官，也是行业内既赞美人工智能前景又警告其风险的代表性人物。唐杰将一种近乎乌托邦式的热情与他所称的“极致安全治理”这一“最重的责任”结合在了一起。 “Once a technology reaches a magnitude of power sufficient to alter the course of civilization, safety is no longer an accessory, but the fundamental precondition for that technology to survive and to be permitted for use,” Mr. Tang said in a letter to staff that was leaked to the Chinese media in July. “当一项技术抵达足以改变文明进程的力量量级时，安全就不再是附属品，而是技术得以存续与被允许应用的根本前提，”唐杰在7月曝光的一封 致员工的信 中这样写道。 Those words may sound strikingly similar to warnings now coming from leading American A.I. labs. But they are better understood through the language of President Xi Jinping of China, for whom A.I. “safety” is ultimately bound to one overriding concern: the security of the Chinese Communist Party regime. 这些话听起来或许与美国顶尖人工智能实验室发出的预警惊人地相似。但若结合中国国家主席习近平的语境来理解，其含义会更加清晰——对习近平而言，人工智能“安全”归根结底指向一个核心关切：中国共产党政权的安全。 While the debate in Western capitals has centered on the dangers A.I. poses to society, the animating concern in China is the threat it poses to the state. Chinese models are already well known for filtering or avoiding politically sensitive information in ways that reflect state censorship. But developers like Mr. Tang are going further, working to embed Communist Party orthodoxy deeply into the models, with potentially far-reaching implications for the values and vulnerabilities that Chinese A.I. systems bring with them. 西方 多国政府 将辩论焦点放在人工智能对社会构成的危险上，中国最关切的则是其对国家政权构成的威胁。中国模型因过滤或规避政治敏感信息以契合国家审查制度而广为人知。但像唐杰这样的开发者正走得更远，他们致力于将执政党意识形态深刻植入模型底层，这对中国人工智能系统所携带的价值观及其潜在脆弱性具有深远影响。 Recognizing these diverging views on the technology that will shape the next century is crucial in setting expectations for the talks on Thursday between President Trump and Mr. Xi at the White House. The leaders are set to discuss how to mitigate A.I. risks. Arriving at meaningful cooperation will be difficult — if not impossible — because there are two almost entirely unrelated conversations about what A.I. safety means happening on opposite sides of the Pacific. 认清对这项将塑造下个世纪的关键技术的理念分歧对于设定特朗普与习近平周四在白宫会谈的预期至关重要。两国领导人准备讨论如何规避人工智能风险。然而，要达成实质性合作将极其困难，甚至难以实现，因为太平洋两岸对于“人工智能安全”的理解完全是两套互不相干的语境。 The wider stakes are potentially enormous. Mr. Tang and his colleagues are instilling values into their models that shape how they interpret the world and respond.
